newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to assess 96 results with IMF next week.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to assess 96 results with IMF next week.

text.p: Venezuelan government officials will meet representatives of the International Monetary Fund next week to assess the country's 1996 macroeconomic results, a top government official said on Friday.

Deputy Planning Minister Armando Leon told reporters the exact day was not yet known "but it will definitely be next week." He did not say whether the meeting would take place in Caracas or in Washington.

Venezuela signed an agreement with the IMF in July, three months after the launch of an IMF-backed adjustment program. A $500 million first installment of a $1.4 billion stand-by loan was disbursed but Venezuela then said it would not use the remainder.
